security.title: SELinux
security.detail: Mandatory access control with SELinux enforcing policies on Linux systems. Review policy context and audit logs when troubleshooting access.

security.title: SSH access
security.detail: SSH key authentication with password login disabled, paired with Fail2ban to monitor authentication events and temporarily ban repeat offenders.

security.title: Network perimeter
security.detail: Host-based Firewalld rules and network segmentation to keep permitted services scoped to their intended zone.

security.title: Crash recovery
security.detail: Kdump reserves memory for a crash kernel and captures diagnostic dumps for post-incident analysis and recovery.

projects.title: RHEL administration & Kdump
projects.summary: RHEL operations, SELinux troubleshooting, and crash recovery with Kdump.
projects.detail: A hands-on administration lab exploring service management with systemd, SELinux context investigation, and Kdump crash-dump configuration and analysis.
projects.architecture: RHEL host → SELinux & systemd operations → reserved Kdump memory → vmcore analysis
projects.snippet:
# Inspect crash-recovery configuration
systemctl status kdump
grubby --info=ALL | grep crashkernel

# Check recent kernel messages
journalctl -k -b -1 --no-pager | tail -n 25

projects.title: Rootless Podman & automounts
projects.summary: Rootless containers alongside resilient systemd automount workflows.
projects.detail: An infrastructure lab combining rootless Podman units with on-demand systemd mount units, focusing on reliable startup and least-privilege operation.
projects.architecture: User session → systemd user unit → rootless Podman container → managed mount
projects.snippet:
# Inspect user services and automounts
systemctl --user list-units --type=service
systemctl list-units --type=automount

# Run a container without root
podman info --format '{{.Host.Security.Rootless}}'

projects.title: LVM storage & backup pipeline
projects.summary: Logical volumes, snapshot-aware backups, and tested recovery paths.
projects.detail: A storage lab covering LVM volume layout and an automated backup workflow, with snapshots used to reason about consistent backups and restoration.
projects.architecture: Physical volumes → volume group → logical volume → backup & restore verification
projects.snippet:
# Inspect logical-volume layout
pvs
vgs
lvs -a -o +devices

# Check the latest backup timer runs
systemctl list-timers --all

projects.title: KVM / QEMU virtualization lab
projects.summary: A virtual test environment for repeatable Linux infrastructure experiments.
projects.detail: A KVM/QEMU virtualization lab for building isolated guests, trying configuration changes, and practicing Linux administration without touching production systems.
projects.architecture: KVM / QEMU host → isolated guest networks → RHEL & Arch Linux virtual machines
projects.snippet:
# Discover virtualization support
lsmod | grep -E '^kvm'

# Review virtual-machine inventory
virsh list --all
virsh net-list --all
